{{nihongo|'''''Tonjiru''''' or '''''butajiru'''''|[[wikt:豚汁|豚汁]]|4="pork soup"}}  is a Japanese soup made with [[pork]] and vegetables, flavoured with [[miso]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Butajiru {{!}} Traditional Soup From Japan {{!}} TasteAtlas|url=https://www.tasteatlas.com/butajiru|access-date=2020-08-18|website=www.tasteatlas.com}}</ref><ref name =ONE/> It is a more substantial version of [[miso soup]], with a larger quantity and variety of ingredients.
